title: Scope-aware strategic authority discoverability for long-horizon work

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 Saga100 conversation: strategic NARR-009 existed in Google Drive but initial narrow CURRENT routing omitted it during long-horizon saga analysis
00 IVDIVO — START HERE — Cross-Conversation Router v1.2 — strategic Saga100 pointer appended and exact-text readback verified

problem_or_opportunity: A router optimized for the freshest active execution frontier can correctly recover the current book yet still omit an older strategic roadmap that is materially authoritative for a long-horizon sequencing question. Fresh execution state and strategic discoverability are different dimensions.
proposed_mechanism: Classify request scope before authority loading. ACTIVE_BOOK_EXECUTION requires current execution/project authority. LONG_HORIZON_SAGA or SAGA_SEQUENCE requires both CURRENT_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY and LONG_HORIZON_STRATEGIC_AUTHORITY. Missing required layer fails closed as STRATEGIC_AUTHORITY_NOT_LOADED. Strategic loading does not override fresher project states; it supplies the macro constraint/seed layer only.

dedupe_analysis.SI-0002: discovers neighboring stronger mechanisms before universal design; does not assert request-scope-specific strategic layer completeness
dedupe_analysis.SI-0013: checks durable project-state coverage/portfolio resumability; does not require long-horizon strategic documents
dedupe_analysis.SI-0015: checks stale embedded CURRENT slices and explicit approval events; does not detect a missing strategic authority layer when the current slice itself is fresh

development_contract.non_override_rule: Strategic authority may constrain macro planning but may not overwrite newer locked/current project facts.
fail_closed: missing strategic layer for long-horizon scope
strategic/current authority contradiction that changes requested outcome

red_team_findings: Do not load every strategic document on every active-book turn; that would increase context cost and stale-conflict noise.
Do not let old strategic roadmaps override current project authority merely because they are required for macro planning.
Scope classifier itself must fail closed if a request mixes active execution and long-horizon restructuring.
